name: send_email
description: Send an email to a contact. Use when user says 'email', 'send email to', 'message', etc. Contacts are looked up by name (e.g., 'Andrew', 'Mom', 'work') from config/contacts.json, or use a direct email address. Rate limited to prevent duplicates.

to.description: Recipient name (from contacts list) or email address. Examples: 'Andrew', 'mom', 'john@example.com'
